headword: {顧客満足|こきゃくまんぞく}

definitions.explanation: The degree to which customers are pleased with a product, service, or experience. A core concept in business management, often measured through surveys and used as a key performance indicator.

examples.japanese: {顧客満足|こきゃくまんぞく}{度|ど}を{向上|こうじょう}させたい。
examples.english: We want to improve customer satisfaction.

examples.japanese: {顧客満足|こきゃくまんぞく}{度|ど}{調査|ちょうさ}の{結果|けっか}を{分析|ぶんせき}した。
examples.english: We analyzed the results of the customer satisfaction survey.

examples.japanese: {高|たか}い{顧客満足|こきゃくまんぞく}を{維持|いじ}するためには、アフターサービスの{充実|じゅうじつ}が{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: To maintain high customer satisfaction, thorough after-sales service is essential.

notes:
Composed of {顧客|こきゃく} (customer/client) + {満足|まんぞく} (satisfaction). Often abbreviated as CS in business jargon. This is a standard business term found in corporate reports, marketing materials, and management discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {顧客満足|こきゃくまんぞく}{度|ど}: customer satisfaction level/score (often abbreviated CS)
- {顧客満足|こきゃくまんぞく}{度|ど}{調査|ちょうさ}: customer satisfaction survey
- {顧客満足|こきゃくまんぞく}を{高|たか}める: to increase customer satisfaction
- {顧客満足|こきゃくまんぞく}{向上|こうじょう}: improvement of customer satisfaction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- CS (シーエス): customer satisfaction (abbreviation) — the abbreviated form commonly used in business
- {利用者|りようしゃ}{満足|まんぞく}{度|ど}: user satisfaction level — for public services rather than commercial customers
- {従業員|じゅうぎょういん}{満足|まんぞく}: employee satisfaction — the internal equivalent, measuring staff happiness
